diagnosis.note: No sentences are classified as Diagnosis; the document never sets out the causes, scale or evidence of small charities' exclusion from commissioning, only asserting that their expertise is valuable (S0017, classed as Proposal).

core_themes.name: Public Service Incubator
core_themes.claim: A place-based incubator that supports high-potential voluntary organisations to build relationships with commissioners, collaborate with local providers and design person-centred services will get small charities commissioned and record the barriers and solutions.

core_themes.name: Commissioning Kitemark
core_themes.claim: A best-practice kitemark of charity-friendly commissioning behaviours achievable under current procurement rules, which commissioners can pledge to, will drive long-term change in commissioning and give small charities fair access.

core_themes.name: VCSE Crown Representative
core_themes.claim: A central crown representative will champion charity-friendly commissioning and act as an intermediary maintaining dialogue between government and the voluntary sector.

core_themes.name: Voluntary sector expertise improves public services
core_themes.claim: Government sees harnessing the expertise of small voluntary organisations as a key route to better public services that meet local needs, which justifies this package of three measures.

proposal.note: The proposal is a package of three separate measures; the document gives no alternatives, costs or evidence for the choice, and some design elements (measuring outcomes, recording barriers) are classed as Testing.

core_themes.name: Voluntary sector-led implementation group
core_themes.claim: A voluntary sector-led implementation group chaired by Sir Martyn Lewis will put the proposals into practice.

core_themes.name: Crown Representative priorities
core_themes.claim: Government is still identifying the key priorities for the Crown Representative so that the role complements the public services programme.

implementation.note: Implementation content is very thin, with no reasons given for the delivery method, no alternatives, and no costs.
